record.what_it_does: Supabase is an open-source backend-as-a-service platform providing a Postgres database, auth, storage, edge functions, and realtime, all controllable via auto-generated REST APIs and a Management API for provisioning projects/organizations.
record.auth_notes: The Management API (for creating/managing projects and orgs) supports both a personal access token (a static Bearer token, user-generated) and OAuth2 for third-party apps acting on behalf of a user. The per-project Data REST API (PostgREST) instead uses project API keys plus Postgres Row Level Security/JWTs for end-user auth, not OAuth2 for developer access.
record.access_notes: Free plan gives immediate self-serve access: sign up and get a project with unlimited API requests on the Data REST API, plus a personal access token for the Management API, at $0/month (with resource caps, e.g. 500MB DB, 2 active projects).

evidence.quote: Personal access token (PAT): PATs are tokens with a custom expiry that you manually generate to access the Management API.
OAuth2 allows your application to generate tokens on behalf of a Supabase user
Supabase offers four plans: Free, Pro, Team, and Enterprise. All plans include unlimited API requests.
Free projects are paused after 1 week of inactivity. Limit of 2 active projects.
Supabase provides a RESTful API using PostgREST, a thin API layer on top of Postgres.
The hosted Supabase MCP server is available at `https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp`.
Database Webhooks allow you to send real-time data from your database to another system whenever a table event occurs.

record.open_questions: The Data REST API (PostgREST, per-project CRUD) breadth scales with the user's own schema rather than a fixed operation count; "broad" here reflects the Management API's coverage (projects, orgs, database, functions, storage config, branching) rather than a literal 50+ fixed-endpoint count — treat as directionally accurate, confirmed via the fetched OpenAPI spec size rather than an endpoint-by-endpoint tally.
